g.text: py-app-sticker-instructie-laadkabel | type sticker | trim 250 x 300 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: tien printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: LaadKabel.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron ja). Template: trim 250 x 300 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 256 x 306 mm.
Variabelen: background-colour = #1A3580; nl-text-1 = Kabel terughangen; nl-text-2 = na gebruik; en-text-1 = Return cable to; en-text-2 = hook after use.

Snijcontour: groep cut-contour, spot ThruCut, 1 pt, 0.2 mm binnen de trim. Proposal: the source has no cut contour. Corner radius 4.2 mm is borrowed from the diefstal footer bar (4.23 mm); to be confirmed by the owner.

Layout measured on LaadKabel.pdf: navy background into the 3 mm bleed, plug icon (light aqua, kept as sampled #68CBDB, no token), NL/EN text Ubuntu 21.47 mm white leading 1.2 centred, white divider 0.706 mm x 170.6 mm, library logo py-atom-logo-horizontal-white scaled by height (beeldmerk 11.1 mm, logo about 40 mm wide) centred at the

bottom. The source blue is CMYK 100/85.9/6.6/0 (drift); the template uses the token blue. Variables: NL text lines and EN text lines as live text (the bold phrases are runs). The cut contour is a proposal: no contour in the source, radius 4.2 mm taken from the diefstal footer.
